name: Extended Family
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of extended family relationships by emphasizing the foundational unity of a man and his wife as one flesh, which establishes the primary family unit from which extended generations arise. The blessing and honor found in multigenerational connections are portrayed as a crown to the elderly and a source of glory to their descendants. Amid these family bonds, believers are reminded to place their trust in God and Christ, anchoring their hearts in faith even as they navigate the responsibilities and joys of extended family life.
